"""Check frozen readiness,independent unit arithmetic and retained comparators."""
import json
import re
import time
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save
from demosaic.prediction_archive import fingerprint

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V164-pair-unit-floor-v1'
index=repo/'docs/results/v164-pair-unit-floor-preparation-v1.json'
output=repo/'docs/results/v164-pair-unit-floor-preparation-verification-v1.json';assert not output.exists()
data=read(index);assert len(data['copies'])==16 and data['source_texts']==48
for item in data['copies'].values():
    assert ref(item['original']['path'])==item['original'] and ref(item['public']['path'])==item['public']
    assert Path(item['original']['path']).read_bytes()==Path(item['public']['path']).read_bytes()
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan);post=read(root/'postprocess-plan-v1.json');guard(post)
bundle=read(data['sources']['path']);assert ref(data['sources']['path'])==data['sources']
assert len(bundle['source_texts'])==48 and len(bundle['unchanged_neural_hashes'])==89
for item in bundle['source_texts']+[bundle['publisher']]:
    assert ref(item['path'])['sha256']==item['sha256'] and Path(item['path']).read_text()==item['text']
for p,h in bundle['unchanged_neural_hashes'].items():assert ref(repo/'src/demosaic'/Path(p).name)['sha256']==h
table=read(plan['pair_unit_table']['path']);cache=read(plan['cache']['path'])
assert len(table['rows'])==len(cache['batches'])==1000
pairs=affected=supervised=0
for entry,batch in zip(table['rows'],cache['batches'],strict=True):
    assert entry['step']==batch['step'] and entry['batch']==batch['arrays']
    variance=np.asarray(batch['metadata']['sensor'].get('increment_mean_variance',[]),dtype=np.float32)
    raw=np.sqrt(variance)
    old=np.maximum(raw,np.float32(16/65535)).reshape(entry['shape'])
    new=np.maximum(raw,np.float32(2/65535)).reshape(entry['shape'])
    assert old.tobytes()==np.array(entry['control_units_FP32'],dtype=np.float32).reshape(entry['shape']).tobytes()
    assert new.tobytes()==np.array(entry['candidate_units_FP32'],dtype=np.float32).reshape(entry['shape']).tobytes()
    assert fingerprint(old)==batch['inputs']['pair_units']
    assert np.all(old>=new) and np.all(old<=8*new)
    pairs+=len(old)
    if not entry['ADC_only']:supervised+=len(old);affected+=int(np.sum(old>new))
assert (pairs,supervised,affected)==(1382,1240,620)
ready=read(root/'readiness-audit-v1.json');assert ready['finite_Adam_states_at10']==94
assert ready['all94_parameter_tensors_have_finite_nonzero_prefix_gradients']
rows=[json.loads(s) for s in Path(ready['training_prefix']['path']).read_text().splitlines()];assert len(rows)==40
old=read(plan['baseline_training']['path'])['trace']
for row,before,units in zip(rows,old[:40],table['rows'][:40],strict=True):
    assert all(row[k]==before[k] for k in ['step','batch','domain','flat_target_mask'])
    expected=before['arms']['harmonic-phase'];assert {k:row['arms']['phase-control'][k] for k in expected}==expected
    for arm,key in [('phase-control','control_units_FP32'),('fine-pair','candidate_units_FP32')]:
        v=np.array(units[key],dtype=np.float32).reshape(units['shape']);assert fingerprint(v)==row['arms'][arm]['pair_unit_values']
design=read(root/'quality-design-v1.json');assert len(design['observations'])==822
parity=read(root/'parity-result-v1.json');assert len(parity['CUDA_anchor_loss_checks'])==10 and len(parity['CUDA_pair_unit_loss_checks'])==6
arrays=0
for binding in post['retained_native_collections'].values():
    assert ref(binding['path'])==binding
    c=read(binding['path']);assert c['module_before']==c['module_after'] and c['RNG_unchanged']
    for row,case in zip(c['observations'],design['observations'],strict=True):
        assert row['id']==case['id'] and row['parent']==case['parent']
        assert ref(row['prediction']['path'])==row['prediction'];arrays+=1
assert arrays==6576
docs=['README.md','docs/index.md','docs/current-model.md','docs/research.md','docs/experiments.md',
    'docs/pair-unit-floor.md','diary/2026-11-07-07-45-23-v164-pair-unit-floor.md']
links=0
for name in docs:
    path=repo/name
    for link in re.findall(r'!?\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)',path.read_text()):
        if '://' in link or link.startswith('#'):continue
        assert (path.parent/link.split('#')[0]).resolve().is_file(),(path,link);links+=1
save(output,{'status':'pass-immutable-readiness-independent-units-and-fixed-comparators','recorded_unix_UTC':time.time(),
    'publication':ref(index),'byte_exact_receipts':16,'source_texts':48,'unchanged_neural_hashes':89,'new_neural_modules':0,
    'actual_CPU_tests':199,'restored_smoke_finite_Adam_states':94,'exact_V163_control_prefix_rows':40,
    'independently_reconstructed_unit_records':1000,'pairs':1382,'supervised_pairs':1240,'supervised_pairs_changed':620,
    'retained_prediction_arrays_checked':arrays,'planned_total_scientific_head_calls':5364,
    'additional_leaf_output_CUDA_backwards':16,'documents':{p:ref(repo/p) for p in docs},'document_links_checked':links,
    'verifier':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),'new_forward_calls':0,'new_noise_draws':0,
    'scope':'Readiness and historical live snapshot only. Full trained quality,all1000 control states/outputs and actual native viewing remain pending.'})
print('PASS16 receipts/48 source texts/89 unchanged neural modules/1000 independent unit records/40 control+unit rows/6576 retained arrays;',links,'links')
